يتدافعا (form VI)
# يَتَدَافَعَا (yatadāfaʕā) /ja.ta.daː.fa.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَدَافَعَ (tadāfaʕa)
# يُتَدَافَعَا (yutadāfaʕā) /ju.ta.daː.fa.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَدَافَعَ (tadāfaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
